provenance.source: Offline fit from vendored Abdella parquet (ADR 0148); corridor duration families fixed, moments matched on n=6. Thermal model replaced by cold-chain break events (schema 2).
provenance.window: Refrigerated leg only: from first lot-mean T < 10 C through published Table 2 duration.

adjustment_notes.gamma: keep gamma_shape=2.0, gamma_scale=0.03571428571428571 (MOD eta_ref=14.0 continuity; not identified from n=6)
adjustment_notes.sigma_pos: keep 0.08 (lognormal psi scale; not identified from n=6; probe temperature sd is not sigma_pos)
adjustment_notes.legs: Deterministic setpoints, duration-weighted. Chosen so phi_set = 1.3389 reproduces the fitted phi_bar centre of the six shipments (mean 1.359), i.e. the break-free limit matches the observed clean-chain regime.
adjustment_notes.breaks: rho (breaks per transit-day) and tau_bar (mean break duration, days) at T_break are ASSUMED, NOT FITTED. All six Abdella shipments are clean chains with no cold-chain break, so a break frequency is not estimable from this data at any confidence. rho=0.08 / tau_bar=0.5 / T_break=12 put a typical break at ~1.2 reference-days and the duration share of Var(Lambda) at ~82%, versus 100% at rho=0. Treat these three numbers as a documented modelling regime, not a measurement.

provenance.notes: Six strawberry logger shipments (not MLE-validated). Arrival freshness remains an upper bound (field heat excluded). short_haul = S2; long_haul = S1,S3-S6. Schema 2 replaces the truncated-normal mean transit temperature (mu_T/sigma_T/temp_floor_c) with a deterministic legged baseline plus compound-Poisson break events; the temperature trace is now the generative primitive and Lambda is integrated out of it.
